settings.about: HOMI collects listings from public Telegram channels. Every card links to the original post.

home.title: HOMI on your home screen
home.added: HOMI icon added to your home screen

found.text: Let us know with one tap — it tells us whether HOMI helps you search.
found.congratsText: Thanks for telling us. If HOMI helped, tell your friends — they’ll find it useful too.
found.shareText: Found my new place through HOMI 🎉 The bot gathers listings from Telegram channels into one feed, removes duplicates, marks owners vs. agents and sends new ones that match your filters. If you’re looking for a place, give it a try — it’s free.
found.landlordShareBot: Hi! I’m moving out. You can find a new tenant for free and without an agent through this Telegram bot: {url}

demo.label: Demo data
demo.hint: This section still runs on test data

error.sessionExpired: The session has expired — close the app and open it again

report.agentHintReview: We’ll check the number and mark it if it’s an agent

soon.title: Radar is coming soon
soon.body: We’ll turn on alerts about new listings shortly.

text.private: The app is available only to the HOMI team for now.

info.verified: The owner confirmed the number from this listing themselves.
info.selfHomi: Listed the flat on HOMI themselves.
info.checked: We checked the number: it has no more than two flats, it isn’t among the agents’ numbers HOMI has seen, and users haven’t marked it as an agent’s.

details.historySelf: The owner listed it on {date}. No price changes yet.
details.historySelfHomi: The owner listed the flat on HOMI {date}. The price hasn’t changed yet.

own.phoneHow: We confirm it with Telegram’s “Share phone number” button — so we know the number is yours. It goes to the HOMI bot only.
own.verified: Verified owner · listed it on HOMI themselves
own.doneText: The flat is in the HOMI feed and is already going out to people whose radar is on.
own.mineEmpty: Flats you rent out through HOMI will appear here.
own.doneTextNoRadar: The flat is in the HOMI feed.
own.disabled: You can’t list a flat yet
own.photoUnreadable: This photo didn’t open — pick another one

review.title: Under review
review.text: We are checking the listing — it is not in the feed yet. Once checked, it will appear on its own.

own.phoneKept: HOMI keeps the number and shows it only the way you choose in the next step.
own.landmarkHint: Everyone who views the listing sees the landmark.
own.demandFew: A few people with a radar are looking for one like this now
own.limitTitle: {max, plural, one {# flat already} other {# flats already}}
own.limitText: You can rent out up to {max, plural, one {# flat} other {# flats}} at once. Mark one “Rented” or remove it, then add a new one.

rejected.limit: {max, plural, one {# flat is} other {# flats are}} already listed with this number. Mark one “Rented” or remove it in “My listings”, then add a new one.

own.withdrawnNote: The listing was taken down. If this is a mistake, write to support.

rejectedReason.limit: {max, plural, one {# flat is} other {# flats are}} already listed with this number.

contact.hiddenBar: The owner hid the number — you can’t contact them through HOMI yet
contact.leadTime: The owner will get your request and answer in the bot — usually within {time}.
contact.noteLimit: The owner will see your Telegram first name and these answers, but not your number. You can send up to {day} requests a day.
contact.noteRelay: The request is passed on to the service where the flat is listed.

err.noChatRestart: The bot can’t write to you — it looks stopped. Open the chat with the bot? Tap “Restart” there and send the request again.
err.requestsFast: Several requests in a row — you can send the next one in {minutes} min.
err.requestsDay: You have sent {day} requests today. You can send more tomorrow.
err.requestsWeek: {week} requests in a week is the limit. You can send new ones in a few days.
